messages:
emily_fin: Hi @luca_vendor, AP flagged invoice INV-5421. It shows Italian VAT (22%) but there's no VAT number on the PDF. Can you confirm your Partita IVA and whether this was billed to Redwood EU (Redwood GmbH) or Redwood Inc (US)? We need to determine if reverse-charge applies.

luca_vendor: Hey Emily, sorry about that oversight. Our legal name is Luca Srl. Partita IVA is IT12345678901. Invoice was addressed to Redwood GmbH (Germany). We thought reverse-charge would apply but our billing team accidentally left VAT on.

aj_tax: If invoice is B2B within EU and Redwood GmbH has a valid VAT ID, this should be reverse-charged (no VAT on vendor invoice). @emily_fin can you confirm Redwood GmbH VAT? We'll also run a VIES check.

nina_ops: Redwood GmbH VAT is DE987654321. Confirmed in our vendor matrix. AP: please keep payment on hold.

paymentsbot: :no_entry: Payment hold placed for INV-5421 due to tax verification issue.

luca_vendor: Understood. Can we reissue a corrected invoice (credit note + new invoice) without VAT, referencing reverse-charge Article 194 VAT Dir? Or do you accept a nota di credito?

aj_tax: Either works technically. Preferred workflow: issue Nota di Credito for INV-5421 and reissue INV-5421-RC with VAT = 0 and a note "Inversione soggettiva (reverse charge) - art. 194 Dir. 2006/112/EC" plus both VAT numbers. That keeps our audit trail clean.

emily_fin: Sounds good. @luca_vendor please reissue and attach XML/PDF. AP will release payment once corrected invoice received and we verify. Also include the original invoice reference on the credit note.

luca_vendor: Will do. Expect new docs by EOD. Sorry for the trouble.

aj_tax: Quick FYI: if they insist on VAT refund, we don't process refunds for EU VAT charged where reverse-charge applies. We need corrected docs.

emily_fin: Thanks everyone. I'll mark the ticket and update when docs arrive. :white_check_mark:
